title: S-20r expr-op-count: Add Coalesce as the 30th ExprOp variant (per master doc amendment; current count is 29)
description: Chore S-20r (revision of black-hat-revised vb-yi78f). Black-hat review round 1 found that the original bead left the master doc owner a blank decision. The actual ExprOp enum is at crates/vb_core/src/workflow/types.rs:456-515 with 29 variants (LoadSlot, LoadConst, LoadAccessor, Eq, NotEq, Gt, Gte, Lt, Lte, And, Or, Not, Add, Sub, Mul, Div, Contains, StartsWith, EndsWith, Has, Exists, Length, Empty, Append, AppendIf, Merge, Sum, Count, Unique). Master doc claims 30. Black-hat proposed 2 candidate 30th variants: RegexMatch (useful for label/ID validation) and Coalesce (returns first non-null — common in idempotency lookups). Decision: add **Coalesce** because (1) it is a primitive operation that has no natural composition from the existing 29 (cannot be expressed as a sequence of `Or`/`If`-style ops), (2) it is a common pattern in idempotency lookups (return the first non-null cached value), (3) it has a clean stack effect: pop two values, push the first if non-null else the second. Real source: vb_core/src/workflow/types.rs:456-515 (the enum), vb_core/src/expr/stack.rs (the stack-effect validator). This bead: (1) add `Coalesce` to ExprOp; (2) add stack-effect handling in check_expr_stack_bound and apply_expr_stack_effect; (3) add 1 test for Coalesce behavior; (4) update master doc §D-24 (or whichever section) to reflect 30 variants. Kani harness: prove Coalesce never underflows the stack. proptest: 100 random (a, b) pairs assert Coalesce(a, b) == a if a is Some else b.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL expose Coalesce as a 30th ExprOp variant
THE SYSTEM SHALL have a stack effect of (pop2, push1) for Coalesce: pop two values, push the first if non-null else the second

event_driven.trigger: WHEN Coalesce is evaluated with a stack [Some(x), None]
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL pop both, push x (the first non-null)

event_driven.trigger: WHEN Coalesce is evaluated with a stack [None, y]
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL pop both, push y (the fallback)

unwanted.condition: IF Coalesce is evaluated with fewer than 2 values on the stack
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT panic on Coalesce stack underflow; it must return ExprStackUnderflow
unwanted.because: Master §45: stack underflow is a typed error, not a panic
